counting_rule: Only the 3,901 parent The Rebbe collection count is recorded as an external discovery inventory. Child/category counts are not summed because overlap or containment has not been resolved.
item_level_locator_pattern: Individual Chabad.org pages use stable aid-based URLs; Living Torah pages may expose event date, disc/program locator, topics and related-text metadata.
rights_status: publicly viewable metadata; copyrighted audiovisual content; no bulk media/transcript copying assumed permitted
provenance_note: Chabad.org pages identify Living Torah/Jewish Educational Media where applicable. Item-level source witness and completeness require per-page inspection.
dedup_strategy: Use event date + aid URL + disc/program + title as candidate keys. Treat repeated niggun titles on different dates as distinct event witnesses unless evidence establishes otherwise.
promotion_queue: Prioritize pages with exact event date, stable aid URL, disc/program locator and related-text link; then link to matching Torat Menachem/sicha witnesses by date without assuming textual identity.
